_comment: Standardized content registry for the keyword-based fallback analysis (used only when the AI analysis - ai_analysis.py - is unavailable).
Each entry in 'drivers' is a self-contained topic: how to detect it, how to score it for ranking, and what copy to show in the Ups/Downs cards, the Impact ranking, and the Recommendations section.

Text fields are Python str.format() templates. Available placeholders: venue data fields (ltr_avg, fun_avg, helpful_avg, issues_pct, resolution_avg, responses), and theme_count/theme_pct for keyword-based drivers. There is deliberately no benchmark_<metric> placeholder - individual venue reports don't assert a network average (see templates/metrics.json's _no_benchmark_comment) - so copy should describe the venue's own numbers, not compare them to 'the network'.

detect types: 'keyword_theme' (matches driver.keywords against comment text, active if count >= min_count), 'metric_compare' (single field/op/value check), 'all'/'any' (list of metric_compare conditions).

score types: 'field_value' (raw metric value), 'keyword_count_pct' (theme mention count / total responses * 100), 'metric_gap_pct' ((target - value) / target * 100), 'metric_ratio_pct' (value / max * 100). Higher score = ranks higher in the Impact section, regardless of polarity.

impact_priority: 'primary' drivers are always candidates for the Impact ranking. 'filler' drivers only become candidates if fewer than 3 primary drivers are active for this venue (keeps a weak/generic signal from crowding out real ones). 'none' means this driver only ever appears in Ups/Downs, never in Impact/Recommendations.

maintain_override_if_detected: if true, this driver's 'maintain' block is used whenever the driver is detected at all - even if it isn't the top-ranked positive driver - because it represents a time-sensitive opportunity (e.g. a new game launch) worth calling out regardless of ranking.

ups_priority / downs_priority: when more than 3 drivers are active at once, the Ups/Downs cards show only 3 bullets (matching the original heuristic) - lower number wins the tie-break. Only drivers with an up_bullet/down_bullet need one.
